keyEvents.text: Goal! Atlanta United 1, Chicago Fire FC 0. Tomás Jacob (Atlanta United) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Miguel Almirón following a fast break.
Delay in match (Chicago Fire FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Atlanta United 1, Chicago Fire FC 1. Anton Salétros (Chicago Fire FC) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner following a corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Chris Brady (Chicago Fire FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Djé D'Avilla (Chicago Fire FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Atlanta United 1, Chicago Fire FC 1.
